description.value: BarBurrito is Canada's largest burrito chain, proudly Canadian since 2005 with 385+ locations nationwide. The Maple Ridge location on Lougheed Highway serves fully customizable Tex-Mex meals including burritos, bowls, tacos, and quesadillas, with a broad range of proteins and toppings assembled to order. A convenient stop for touring cyclists looking for a fast, filling meal with vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options available.

address.value: 20395 Lougheed Hwy, Maple Ridge, British Columbia V2X 2P9

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 60m; rack (3 spaces) at 79m. Total: 3 spaces.
